### He (Not Me) Has the Whole World in His Hands
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/he-not-me-has-the-whole-world-in-his-hands/
Passage: Job 12:10
Points:
- God sovereignly holds the life and breath of every creature in His hands.
- Recognizing God's complete control frees believers from the exhausting burden of trying to manage everything themselves.
- Believers can surrender the remaining days of their lives to God's purpose, grace, and wisdom.
- Instead of worrying over the painful circumstances or decisions of loved ones, we can trust God as the author of their stories.
- Keeping our eyes fixed on God reigning from heaven's throne replaces anxiety about worldly uncertainties with deep peace.
